description: Port of grammars-v4 Go: ANTLR's NLSEMI lexer mode as a lexical state, so a line break, ';' or multi-line comment after a statement-ending token is an EOS token; eos is empty before ')' or '}' (before()) or at the end of input (at_end()); a statement cannot continue across an EOS, and two statements on one line need a ';'.
